name: NPC_Trade_Mechanics
description: Dynamic trade bargaining system with supply/demand, reputation modifiers, cultural negotiation styles, and educational game theory mechanics.

questions.question: System models supply/demand elasticity, BATNA, value creation via bundle trades, anchoring, and reciprocity. Player learns real negotiation and game theory through practice, not reading.
questions.answer: System models supply/demand elasticity, BATNA, value creation via bundle trades, anchoring, and reciprocity. Player learns real negotiation and game theory through practice, not reading.

questions.question: NPC-specific bargaining with cultural negotiation styles and game-theoretic models is unique in space games. A player who successfully negotiates using cultural insight creates shareable 'smart player' content.
questions.answer: NPC-specific bargaining with cultural negotiation styles and game-theoretic models is unique in space games. A player who successfully negotiates using cultural insight creates shareable 'smart player' content.

questions.question: NPCs have different bargaining styles per culture. Trade reputation is persistent per-faction. Prices fluctuate with supply, demand, and external events. Barter system for cultures that prefer relationship-based trade over currency.
questions.answer: NPCs have different bargaining styles per culture. Trade reputation is persistent per-faction. Prices fluctuate with supply, demand, and external events. Barter system for cultures that prefer relationship-based trade over currency.

questions.question: Extends UE5 inventory system. Data-driven: commodity definitions, price tables, cultural templates. Basic buy/sell barter prototypes in 3-5 days. Full bargaining AI adds another sprint.

questions.question: Tool inventory exists. NPC inventory extension needed (storage, value assessment, trade authorization). Data-driven, extensible via data tables.

questions.question: C++ actor components, UMG trade interface, data tables. All standard UE5.8. No engine modifications.

questions.question: UI-driven, negligible CPU cost. Price calcs are simple arithmetic. No GPU impact.

questions.question: Price indicators use text labels AND icons. Bargaining feedback is text. Audio supplementary, not required.

questions.question: v1: simple UI sounds (select, confirm, complete). Cultural trade sounds (Keeper bell, Trader coin) are v2.

questions.question: v1 single-player only. Multiplayer trade needs dedicated manager. Out of scope.

questions.question: Commodity definitions, price tables, cultural bargaining profiles are JSON/DataTable. Fully content-moddable.

questions.question: All text (items, descriptions, bargaining phrases, cultural notes) uses FText. Standard localization pipeline.

questions.question: Depends on NPC_AI_Behavior (willingness to trade, current activity). Partially depends on dialogue for full bargaining (basic buy/sell works with simple menu alone).
